text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
"If I resolve to do it, I will achieve it 
without fail." Seeing Symboli Kris S 
strive day and night, Zenno Rob Roy was 
certain of her victory in the Japanese 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
However... the result was 2nd place. 
Seeing the hero she believed in suffer 
defeat, Zenno Rob Roy was utterly 
devastated.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
However, Symboli Kris S stated in an 
interview, "From here on, I will simply do 
what must be done, until it is finished."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
"Even in defeat, the tip of her sword 
always pointed straight toward the future. 
Zenno Rob Roy drew strength from that 
sight."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Wishing to become a beacon of light for 
others—she resolved to be an "unwavering" 
hero who could inspire courage and hope 
with a single swing of her sword.
